title: Good Practices in Model-Informed Drug Discovery and Development: Practice, Application, and Documentation

content.abstract_summary: An EFPIA MID3 workgroup paper proposes good-practice recommendations to improve consistency in model-informed drug discovery and development practice, application, and documentation.
key_findings: MIDD planning, application, and documentation benefit from shared good-practice expectations.
The paper frames model-informed work as a decision-support process spanning development and regulatory interaction.
It provides an established pharmacometrics foundation for the Credibility Evidence Package.
limitations: Published before current AI/ML-specific regulatory guidance; does not operationalize hybrid-model lifecycle controls.

gaps_addressed: MIDD evidence planning and documentation for AI/ML-augmented pharmacometric models

provenance.notes: Focused regulatory-lifecycle search; full-text follow-up is warranted before external guidance is drafted.
